verdict.rationale: v0 has its own documented ways to get work out of the platform. It can push generated code to your own GitHub repository, and the Platform API lists "export capabilities for backup and migration." However, the evidence only covers code and projects; nothing shows that all user data (chat history, design systems, settings) can be exported in open formats, or details what the API export contains. missing for 10: documented full-account data export, explicit open-format specification for non-code data (chats, prompts, design tokens), details of the API export scope, independent or hands-on corroboration of migrating away.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
